response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrable experience with Java/Kotlin, JVM tooling, Spring ecosystem, or IDE internals — core requirements for this role. Their work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only brief, unverified Java exposure in past roles without context on enterprise tooling or IDE development.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and platforms
Proven track record in open-source tooling and developer education
Extensive experience with CI/CD, testing, and dev-ops infrastructure
concerns: No evidence of enterprise Java/Kotlin or Spring framework experience
No demonstrated work on IDEs, language servers, or JVM tooling internals
Java appears only as a minor footnote in past roles without depth or ownership
